nullPolicy: Blank remains null/unknown, never zero. Blank scope is unspecified.
comparability: iRAD is a different series from the Delhi Traffic Police crash report and NCRB. Reporting districts are not the 15 police districts. Coverage differs by district. Annual/cumulative station windows overlap monthly windows and are not twelve independent observations.
sourceLinkCaveat: Public links recovered 2026-10-18 by an independent check (Codex). Each file was matched to the currently published official PDF by identical SHA-256. This proves the same bytes are published now, not which URL the original collection used. Entries for files added after the second check come from its inventory of published reports.
